svg.aria-label: An orchestrator agent takes in requests, context and signals, divides the work into tasks and schedules them on the durable execution layer beneath it, a separate system that starts each agent in its own sandbox behind its own proxy; it proposes each task's profile and scope to the authorization service, which alone grants access. Monitoring agents watch the work from outside, changes go through approval and deploy to production, and incidents, scanner findings, monitoring and evals come back as signals that start new work.

g.text: plans the work and divides it into tasks
each part to its own agent,
telemetry and evals across all runs
